statement: ActaKit should use a quality-gated escalation ladder rather than one universal processor.
actakit_implication: Default to cheapest deterministic/local successful rung and escalate only on quality evidence.

statement: Docling is the strongest current candidate for ActaKit’s built-in structured-document orchestration layer, but must win Civic Processor Bench before freeze.
actakit_implication: Benchmark/adopt after evidence; keep ActaKit contracts independent from Docling internals.

statement: Poppler/pdftotext should remain the first PDF text path for born-digital documents.
actakit_implication: Do not pay OCR/VLM cost when native extraction passes quality gates.

statement: OCRmyPDF + Tesseract is the preferred classical PDF OCR baseline.
actakit_implication: Reuse mature rasterize/preprocess/OCR grafting and retain Tesseract-native quality signals.

statement: PaddleOCR-VL is the leading specialized local visual-document AI candidate for the hard-document rung.
actakit_implication: Benchmark as D4 local specialist; not default for all docs.

statement: A general multimodal model such as Qwen3-VL is a useful local escape hatch for unusual visual/handwritten material but is generative.
actakit_implication: Constrain outputs, preserve page/image anchors, measure hallucination, and escalate only after lower rungs fail.

statement: Specialized cloud Document AI can outperform generic local paths on difficult documents but introduces egress, vendor and marginal-cost policy.
actakit_implication: Mistral OCR is an opt-in D4 specialist candidate; record provider/model/version/egress as provenance.

statement: There is no defensible universal numeric confidence across processors/modalities.
actakit_implication: Core stores typed, namespaced QualityEvidence and evaluates ACCEPT/ESCALATE/QUARANTINE policy.

statement: Selective page/block escalation is established practice and can preserve efficiency.
actakit_implication: Allow escalation granularity below whole-document where a processor can address a failing page/block with stable provenance.

statement: Code license and model-weight/provider license are separate deployment facts.
actakit_implication: Capability registry/pin must audit code, model and service terms independently.

statement: For audio, faster-whisper is the provisional local ASR baseline, whisper.cpp is a portable alternate, and diarization is optional/separate.
actakit_implication: Do not install/ship diarization until a source requires speaker attribution.

statement: Processor selection requires a civic-specific benchmark rather than vendor or public leaderboard scores alone.
actakit_implication: Civic Processor Bench is a mandatory gate before WORKBENCH processor freeze/implementation.

statement: Original custody must never be mutated by preprocessing/OCR/AI; every attempt/result is derived with ProcessRun provenance.
actakit_implication: Escalation creates new representations/evidence, not silent replacement.

statement: ActaKit should avoid simultaneously adopting multiple overlapping document frameworks.
actakit_implication: One curated primary framework plus narrowly justified specialist backends.

statement: Network/telemetry/model-fetch behavior is part of processor security policy.
actakit_implication: Local processors run network-off by default; model acquisition and cloud egress are explicit host actions.

statement: Cloud AI must be modeled as a first-class execution venue/capability family rather than architecture hard-coded around one cloud OCR vendor.
actakit_implication: Benchmark OpenAI frontier multimodal beside specialized Mistral and local candidates; processor semantics stay provider-neutral.

statement: OpenAI-compatible APIs are a useful de-facto transport convention but do not guarantee endpoint, parameter or multimodal feature parity.
actakit_implication: Support a capability-gated OpenAI-compatible provider escape hatch; never treat API shape as a universal standard.

statement: Cloud/provider API credentials are operational bearer secrets, not civic evidence or processor quality data.
actakit_implication: Resolve secrets outside SQLite/provenance/logs; only non-secret provider/model/endpoint identities may be recorded.

statement: Cloud execution requires explicit egress and provider data-control provenance even when provider business-data policy is strong.
actakit_implication: Record off-device processing and deployment retention profile; no-egress source policy can forbid cloud rungs.

statement: The Civic Processor Bench must compare the best qualified local hard-case path against the best allowed cloud path rather than preselect venue by ideology or developer hardware.
actakit_implication: Measure quality, hallucination, latency, resource use, monetary cost and egress; weak hosts may legitimately prefer cloud D4/D5.
